explication: Agent Governance Toolkit governs autonomous-agent actions across policy, identity, approvals, sandboxing, MCP, and reliability controls. The principal workflow is: an agent or integration submits an action; middleware or a gateway routes it to the governance kernel; policy and trust checks produce a decision; enforcement either blocks, approves, or executes the action; audit and operational evidence record the result. The tree shows parallel Python, .NET, Go, and editor integrations. Some subsystem wiring is inferred only from documented capabilities and sampled entrypoints.
